mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the surviving knot with the cold cloud was most worthwhile: it brought the old pillars' material into a new generation of stars.

leastWorthwhile.text: Carrying dust with the outflow was the least revealing passage on its own; it mainly set up what happened next.

surprise.text: I was interested that dust warmed by starlight could later be eroded by hot gas, returning its material to the gas.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt particularly arbitrary; the chapter's introduction pointed to both dust paths, and the hot outer gas was a plausible destination.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow how the dispersed material and young stars develop, especially after seeing material recur in different forms.
